items.title: Net FDI inflows drop 28% in first half of 2026
items.description: Bangladesh recorded a sharp decline in net foreign investment inflows in the first half of 2026 as fresh equity inflows from international investors slumped, raising concerns.

items.title: Consumers paying the price for lax LPG monitoring
items.description: Consumers are paying Tk 400 or more than the government-set rates for a cylinder of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), as weak market monitoring allows retailers to overcharge, according to local LPG operators.

items.title: Walton to expand in Kenya
items.description: Walton Hi-Tech Industries is set to expand its market presence in Kenya through a partnership with Nairobi-based North Light Holdings.

items.title: Foreign debt rises to $114.98b
items.description: Bangladesh’s foreign debt grew by 3.65 percent from the previous quarter to reach $114.98 billion at the end of the April-June quarter of fiscal year 2026, according to central bank data.

items.title: Marubeni eyes new investments in Bangladesh
items.description: Japanese conglomerate Marubeni Corporation is interested in expanding its existing investments in Bangladesh and entering new industrial sectors, including fertiliser production, information technology and ship recycling.

items.title: Airlines business and procurement of aircraft
items.description: Operating an airline is not just a business or a service; it also represents a country as its flag carrier.

items.title: US consumer sentiment dips as cost worries mount: survey
items.description: US consumer sentiment ticked down in October, survey data showed Friday, with sharp declines seen among those with lower incomes as cost of living worries in the world’s largest economy soar.
